prose:
Gary Marcus’s accessible opening argues against Anthropic’s IPO valuation and questions extrapolating rapid revenue growth indefinitely. He combines an investment critique with a stated moral objection to buying shares.

The paid article was only partly readable, and the cited charts and underlying financial assumptions were not independently audited. This is the author’s opinion, not investment advice or a verified forecast that the company will fail.
highlights: Author states a moral objection as well
Underlying financial figures were not audited
Opinion does not establish future returns
